rationale: A fire caused damage to the policyholder's own property (kitchen cabinets and ceiling/walls) with no third party at fault—this is a covered peril under the homeowners policy and clearly property damage.
severity_rationale: Localized fire damage to kitchen cabinets and smoke damage to ceiling and walls, with no injuries and no structural damage to the building; estimated loss likely in the $5,000–$50,000 range, within policy limits.
claim_summary: Grease fire in kitchen on stove (contained with extinguisher). Charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling/walls. No injuries, no structural damage. Claimant is POL-1001 (Alex Doe) with active homeowners coverage, $500 deductible, $250k limit.

case_facts.description: grease fire on stove, extinguished with fire extinguisher, charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof with no third-party involvement is a straightforward covered peril under property damage.
severity_rationale: Estimated loss of $400 is well under $5,000, no injuries, and damage is limited to four shingles with no water intrusion or structural concerns.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; approximately four shingles blown off. No water intrusion. Estimated repair cost $400. Deductible $2,500 applies.

case_facts.description: Wind caused approximately four shingles to blow off the roof overhang; no water intrusion or additional damage
